item.subject: science
item.stem: Meera is making a chart about movements in space for her school exhibition in Jaipur. Her teacher says she must label each movement correctly. Which row of her chart is correct?

options.A: Earth spinning about its own axis is called revolution.
options.B: The Moon moving around the Earth is an example of a satellite moving around a planet.
options.C: A spacecraft built by humans and orbiting the Earth is not a satellite.
options.D: The planets spinning on their axes is the reason they revolve around the Sun.
